Potentially AI PLC releases Q&A with Company co-founder along with consumer app demonstration
Potentially AI PLC (AIM: AGI), the collective AI company, has today released a recorded question and answer session with the Company's co-founder and chief architect, Sukhveer Sanghera.

The session, which covered topics including the Company's background and its overarching thesis, the consumer problem it is addressing, the engineering behind its platform and the measures the Company will be judged on over the next year, was hosted by non-executive director of Potentially, Lord Dominic Johnson.
It was published on the Company's X page and is available at the following link - https://x.com/potentially_agi.
Product demonstration

During the session a screen-recorded demonstration of the platform - providing a series of worked examples in which models and modalities are changed mid-conversation while the thread and its context remain intact - was shown. The worked examples included:
·    A text model being used to develop a brief, with a 3D model subsequently being brought into the thread to build an object from it
·    Work produced by a one text model being passed to a different text model to be critiqued and assessed
·    A reference image being used to create the same image with a second character, then subsequently changing to a different model whilst maintaining context, to create a third character

In each case the user selects the model directly, the platform carries the context of everything that came before, and no information is re-entered. Every model used is drawn against a single Potentially credit balance, with no separate subscription, account or payment relationship for any provider.
Product rollout

Potentially's consumer app is in beta ahead of full launch. The Company is gathering critical feedback from early users and continues to rapidly develop the product, with the Q&A addressing both what the platform does today and what remains in development.

About Potentially

Potentially are pioneers in the collective AI space. We are building a unique aggregator infrastructure for the emerging AI economy, allowing users access to over 1,000 of the world's most powerful open-source AI models, along with those from the Frontier Labs. Through Potentially, users can find new ways of solving the same problems, while increasing the value of their token spend and maintaining near-100% control of their data. Founded in London, United Kingdom, Potentially will offer AI sovereignty without the need to develop new frontier models, ensuring that growth stays in the hands of the many, not the few. In H2 2026, Potentially will launch three products; a consumer app, a professional workplace and a marketplace to allow users to develop their product, create bespoke spaces and monetise their creations, ensuring individuals can create their own wealth through the AI economy. https://potentially.ai/
